name: softmeal.org MCP Server
description: IDDSI care food recipes (884 recipes) and dysphagia knowledge articles from softmeal.org — Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and English.
operator: Full Linkage Community Care Association Limited

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search IDDSI-compliant care food recipes by texture level, locale, dietary tags, or free-text query.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get a specific recipe by slug. Returns full metadata including IDDSI level, prep time, difficulty, and tags.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search dysphagia knowledge articles and caregiver guides (IDDSI, stroke, Parkinson's, dementia, texture modification).

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get a specific article by slug. Returns metadata and canonical URL.

tools.name: iddsi_classify
tools.description: Heuristically classify a food or drink into an IDDSI texture level (0–7) based on a texture description.
